_evidence: 0x543a93 (edx=5 zoom-out) for each 3-dword block 0x8310c0/0x8310cc: size' = min(2*[+8], [+4]) (unsigned jbe), then edx:eax = [+4]*0x4000 (signed imul) and, if size' != 0, idiv size'. With |limit| <= 0x10000 the dividend is at most 2^30 in magnitude and |size'| >= 1, so the quotient always fits; larger limits overflow the idiv (#DE) in the original. Composed after scroll_00543340, which draws all four dwords as any i32: here +4 (limit) and +8 (size) come from value sets that keep that bound and include zero sizes, wrap-to-zero (0x80000000) and sizes above the limit, so both the clamp and the je-zero paths occur.
